notation.styles: CSS property names in kebab case. Colours and fonts reference Webflow variables as var(--<variable-name>), names from figma/tokens.json and docs/figma/decisions.md (K01 reconciles them with the live names after Q001).
notation.breakpoints: desktop = main (992px and up), tablet = medium (991px), mobileLandscape = small (767px), mobilePortrait = tiny (479px). Only values that change are listed per breakpoint.
notation.combos: familyClasses entries with comboOn are Webflow combo classes: they exist only on top of that base class. Webflow cannot style a child from a parent combo, so every element that changes in a variant carries its own combo.
notation.tree: Every node has a slot id. instances[] and previewInstances[] say which slots are hidden, which combos and utility swaps each slot takes, and the content.

content.body-1: As the YMCA that welcomed Army and Navy men and women, The Guild was the city’s premier gathering place. The experience has been curated, elevated and refined – but at heart, we’re still a sailor on shore leave.

content.heading: George Marston
content.body-1: In 1924, George Marsden saw more than a building. He imagined a grand center of city life, a gathering place to elevate hospitality and raise a downtown. The Italian Renaissance icon he built welcomed and entertained some eight million servicemen and women.
content.body-2: The Guild preserves the existing structure, retains defining architectural elements, and incorporates materials that will age gracefully,  extending the life of this important civic landmark.

openQuestions: Variables: color-brand-906e58 (tan) and color-brand-00263e (blue) are figma/tokens.json suggestions; D01 only names #CB3629 and #4A1217. Confirm Q001 creates both, and color-neutral-300 for the image placeholder fill and list rules (K01).

Base text colour: rooms-individual and arts use #29310C (color-accent), neighborhood and dining use #262118 (color-neutral-900). The plan uses color-neutral-900 for all base instances. Accept, or add an is-accent-text combo?

Dining template section 02 is one CMS template (cms-dining): zuma is blue with an image (s02-image), the other three are olive with no image. One template cannot switch a section combo per item. Options: two component instances (blue and olive) with conditional visibility on a CMS option field, or a CMS colour field bound to the section background. Needs a decision before Q027.
history/04: the portrait shows three slider dashes at its bottom edge, which suggests a multi-image slider. The plan treats it as one image. Confirm one image, or route it to a slider entry.
history/04 stamp SVG (figma/vectors/group-263x263-228-7875.svg) is not uploaded to Webflow (webflowAssetId null). Upload before the history page entry.

neighborhood/05: the burgundy pill nav (dining, arts, beyond downtown, services) inside the crop is not part of this component. It looks like a sticky in-page nav that belongs to another entry; leave its slot to that entry or a manual overlay.
Text that sits in a CMS template (dining-*, happenings-indiv, blog-indiv) should bind to CMS fields once C01 creates them; the props here are static component props.
meetings-collection/08 (brief variant is-tall) was moved out of this component as a unique item, per Stephen's rule for unsure variant calls. Its page entry builds it; confirm that is acceptable.
deviations: Brief modifiers is-media-left and is-1-image are not created: media-left and one image are the defaults, so the classes would carry no styles. Second images use the is-secondary combo on a second figure.
is-compact is not a section combo: it is padding-section-medium plus placement combos, with no section-level style.

The brief lists 0 images for every variant except tan and blue, but every reference crop has grey placeholder rectangles (#D9D9D9, #C4C4C4) in image positions. The plan keeps those as image slots with a color-neutral-300 placeholder fill.

Base instances use four layouts (edge, split, stagger, wide). They are expressed as element combos on the media and content (grid placement on a 12-column grid), not as extra section variants, because Webflow combos cannot style children from the section.

Webflow component variants: one component with variants base, olive, blue, tan, compact plus layout variants edge, stagger-left, stagger-mid, wide, so instances pick a variant instead of re-classing elements. If component variants cannot change classes on nested elements, fall back to unlinked layout overrides per instance.
Morello script heading uses heading-style-h1 plus a new shared text-style-script combo (font family, 5rem/1, no transform), because heading-style-h1 is Sackers.
Brief variant is-tall (meetings-collection/08) is not part of this component; see excludedInstances.

Q017 build (2026-10-20): eight stacks had no combo path, so this session created them empty with Stephen's yes: .split-image-text-light_eyebrow.text-style-eyebrow-caps, .split-image-text-light_heading.heading-style-h4, .split-image-text-light_heading.heading-style-h4.text-weight-normal, .split-image-text-light_heading.heading-style-h3, .split-image-text-light_heading.heading-style-h3.text-weight-normal, .split-image-text-light_body.text-size-medium, .split-image-text-light_caption.text-size-medium and .button.is-link.text-style-caps-caption-16.

Q017 build: colour variants (is-olive, is-blue, is-tan), compact and the base layouts (edge, staggerLeft, staggerMid, wide) change classes on the section and nested elements, which a component instance cannot switch. They exist on the build page as plain reference sections below the component, not instances (same pattern as Q014). Webflow component variants were not used.

Q017 build: the component default content is neighborhood/03 (downtown san diego, split layout), the only base instance that uses the tree default classes. Placeholder copy fills the hidden slots: Eyebrow, Body 2, Learn more.
Q017 build: the eight visibility props are booleans bound to each optional slot, because Webflow cannot hide an element when its prop is empty.

Q017 build: image slots without an asset are left as empty Image elements. Images with an asset (blue, tan) inherit the library alt; no alt was written. The plan alt is empty, so mark them decorative in the Designer if the library alt should not apply.
Q017 build: the tan stamp has no asset (figma/vectors/group-263x263-228-7875.svg is not uploaded), so its Image is empty on the tan reference section.
Q017 build: the tan heading stays an h2 (not the h1 the brief suggested), as in the tree and Q012.
Q017 build: CTA links are a # url placeholder.

V02 (2026-10-20): every plan variant and base layout is now a style-only Webflow component variant (Olive, Blue, Tan, Compact, Edge, Stagger Left, Stagger Mid, Wide); no separate components. Each variant copies its combo values onto the base classes inside the component: section_split-image-text-light (colour), container-large (max-width none stands in for container-full; Compact also gets negative margin-top and margin-bottom of 2, 1.5, 1 and 0.5rem per breakpoint, which turns the padding-section-large spacing into the padding-section-medium spacing), split-image-text-light_media, _content and _header. Visibility stays on props: page builds turn on Second image for Edge and Wide, Stamp for Tan, Header off for Compact, Footer where a CTA shows.

V02: the Tan script heading is variant styles on split-image-text-light_heading (font family, 5rem/4rem/3.25rem/2.75rem, line height 1.2, weight 400, text-transform none), copied from text-style-script plus is-large, because a variant cannot swap the heading classes.
V02: arts/05 (Edge) uses an h3-size heading; the Edge variant keeps the h4 size, since only one of three Edge instances needs h3. See follow-ups.

V02: variant styles only reach an element through its first class. Styles first set on padding-section-large and heading-style-h4 (combo-position classes) published as CSS but never matched, because the element got no w-variant class; they were moved to padding-global and split-image-text-light_heading. A padding-global variant style then did apply as a class but lost to .padding-section-large, which comes later in the stylesheet at the same specificity, so Compact uses container margins instead.

previewAssumptions.note: Element stand-ins for the preview only. K01 removed the class and variable stand-ins: previews load ../shared-preview.css instead.

excludedInstances.reason: Sticky intro beside three image-and-list feature cards; a different structure from the rest of the cluster. Built as a unique item in the meetings-collection page entry (Stephen 2026-10-19: when unsure between a component variant and a unique item, make it a unique item).

Class list `heading-style-h1 text-style-script (replaces heading-style-h4)` is now `text-style-script is-large (replaces heading-style-h4)`.
Class list `split-image-text-light_heading heading-style-h1 text-weight-normal text-style-script` is now `split-image-text-light_heading text-style-script is-large`.
Script heading overrides (tan variant) use `text-style-script is-large`; line height is 1.2 (80/96) instead of the measured 1.
Section colour modifiers `is-tan` and `is-blue` need the new Colors/Tan and Colors/Navy variables.
